увести.gloss: to lead away, take away, steal (a partner)

meanings.note: On foot. Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'вести'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to lead away, take away, steal (a partner)', paired with 'уводить'.
